description: Bucks County, PA— The Service Employees International Union (SEIU) Pennsylvania State Council has formally endorsed Brian Fitzpatrick for re-election, delivering one of the clearest statements yet in the race for Pennsylvania’s First Congressional District. The SEIU Pennsylvania State Council brings together unions representing tens of thousands of workers across Pennsylvania, including SEIU Healthcare Pennsylvania, 32BJ
